author: GamingBolt
description:
We knew this was going to happen, and it was just a matter of waiting patiently until we got our hands on GTA 6 for the PS5 Pro and pitch it against GTA 5 Enhanced edition on the PC. GTA 5 does have a bunch of gimmicks to make its visuals look and feel like they were powering a game ahead of its time, and it would have stood the test of time if the studio hadn’t spent the last thirteen years building on all of those improvements and more for GTA 6.

The result is Loenida, a state that’s leaving its predecessor behind in the dust, where it’s going to occupy a special place in the franchise’s past, while GTA 6 charts a bold course into the future with some very strong visual direction underlining Rockstar’s effort. This is a battle of heavyweights you don’t want to miss, so grab your popcorn and let’s begin.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Graphics Tech Detailed - Unlike Anything We've Seen [A Big Jump From GTA 5]

author: GamingBolt
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally upon us, and with how massive the world can be, and the sheer number of systems - either new or heavily changed- you'll spend a lot of time learning what to do (and probably dying in the process). But before all that, it helps to configure a few settings before even embarking on your first mission/mass slaughter.

As is tradition, GTA 6 offers a plethora of settings to configure, from your movement and aiming to the UI and even certain cinematic elements. Some can even make a huge difference to the gameplay, even if it slightly bends the balance in favor of the player.
title: GTA 6 - Do These 15 Things FIRST

author: GamingBolt
description:
Reviewing GTA 6 has been a blast thanks to Rockstar sparing no effort to create the most ambitious open world it’s developed to date and backing that up with a story, cast, and gameplay loop that often intersect with style. Leonida is going to take a lot of your time once you set foot in it, and not a minute of it is going to feel like a waste.

You get to be whoever you’d like to be in its streets, and you can sure that the world is going to get back to you about the things you do in it. We’ve covered as much ground as we can with this one and left the rest for you to experience. Join us as we take you around the city and perhaps let you decide if its sights and sounds are alluring enough for you to dive into right away.
title: GTA 6 Review
